output.question: Has PepsiCo announced layoffs?
output.answer: Yes. On November 9, 2026, PepsiCo said it is cutting about 1,000 jobs across its North American business, according to CNBC. The Wall Street Journal broke the story first, and CNBC reported the cuts would happen over the following week. In a letter to employees, PepsiCo North America CEO Ram Krishnan said the company must be "faster, more connected, and more capable." The cuts follow PepsiCo's October 2026 cut to its full-year earnings outlook, after third-quarter North American beverage volume fell 2% and food volume was flat. MarketScreener (citing S&P Capital IQ) says the cuts cover the North American food and beverage businesses and are part of a wider restructuring that sped up after activist investor Elliott took a stake of about $4 billion in 2025.

key_facts.fact: PepsiCo is cutting about 1,000 jobs across North America. The cuts were announced Monday, Nov 9, 2026, and were to happen over the following week.

Ram Krishnan, CEO of PepsiCo North America, wrote to employees that "we need to be faster, more connected, and more capable." The stated goal is to streamline operations and better connect teams across the North American business.
In October 2026 PepsiCo cut its full-year earnings outlook. Q3 North American beverage volume fell 2% and food volume was flat. CFO Steve Schmitt said "the turnaround is taking longer than expected."
PepsiCo has about 306,000 employees worldwide, about 125,000 of them in the U.S. (company filing, as of Dec 27, 2025).

The cuts cover PepsiCo's North American food and beverage businesses and are part of a broader restructuring, not a separately quantified cost-saving target. The turnaround gained momentum after Elliott took a stake of about $4B in 2025.

caveats: 'About 1,000' is an approximate figure from media reports (WSJ first, then CNBC). I did not find a PepsiCo press release or SEC filing that states the number.
The sources do not give a breakdown by role, function or location.
A third-party AI-layoff tracker (ailayoffs.org) lists smaller PepsiCo reductions earlier in fall 2026, including a bottling plant in Cheverly, MD. I did not open or verify that page.
Restructuring charges or severance amounts tied to these cuts may show up in later SEC filings and were not checked.
